theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_si_coarea_signed_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : ℝ → Measure (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞) (q : Euclid P → ℝ), (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t)) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x, φ x ∂(ν t) = ∫⁻ x, w x * φ x ∂μ) → Measurable w → Measurable q → ∫⁻ x, w x * ‖q x‖ₑ ∂μ ≠ ∞ → Integrable (fun t => ∫ x, q x ∂(ν t)) ∧ ∫ t, ∫ x, q x ∂(ν t) = ∫ x, (w x).toReal * q x ∂μ
